thread:
marta: Onboarding lark-11b (int4) canary. Hit 2 OOMs when batch_size=8 and prefetch_kv=true. Anyone seen high concurrent kv reservations with long generations? :frowning:

jon: Was this during a multi-turn summarization? Can you paste the worker log line?

marta: Yep, single long-gen ~280 tokens. Log: `AllocFailure: tried to alloc 1.8G for new kv cache; prefetch_kv=true; batch=8; slot_compactor=off`.

devon: Likely interaction of default max_new_tokens=256 + prefetch. For int4 params are small but kv grows with seq len. Recommend lowering route default max_new_tokens and microbatching.

alice: Eval flagged ~2% ROUGE-L drop vs fp16 on long prompts. So need guardrails before we change quant defaults widely.

jon: Proposed quick canary config: max_new_tokens=120, batch_size=4, prefetch_kv=false, compactor_interval=30s. Rollout window tonight?

marta: Sounds good. Ill add heap dump & traces to ML-5973 and schedule canary.

eval-bot: Queued: `rcli eval --model lark-11b --quant int4 --baseline fp16 --prompts long_prompts_200 --samples 200`. ETA ~40m.

infra-bot: Canary slot reserved 2026-03-24T02:00Z UTC. Applying route defaults and enabling compactor. Alerting on kv_reserve_ratio > 0.6.

devon: If memory spikes persist, enable per-request prefix eviction for long sessions (evict oldest prefixes) and consider per-layer quant calibrate if quality loss persists.

alice: If eval shows >1.5% regression, prefer a small 100-step float fine-tune per-layer before expanding the route defaults.

jon: Plan: apply canary config, run eval, monitor OOMs and kv histograms for 6h, then soft-rollout if stable. Thanks. :thumbsup:

marta: Will update ML-5973 with results.
